title: Form Energy split
description: A plain two-column band: a large 6px-rounded photo (628×500 on desktop) on one side and, centred against it, an orange-ruled condensed uppercase title, a light paragraph and an orange-outlined mono button that fills orange on hover. On phones the photo comes first, then the text and a full-width button.
notes: mediaSide puts the photo left or right on desktop; tone picks the grey or white band, so stacked splits can alternate
media is cropped like object-fit: cover; empty, it is a placeholder at the original's size
